definition: relating to the area of the body around the stomach
example: Diet and floor exercises, such as abdominal crunches, can help to get rid of a pot belly.
exampleEs: La dieta y los ejercicios en el suelo, como los abdominales, pueden ayudar a deshacerse de una barriga prominente.
cloze: Diet and floor exercises, such as ____ crunches, can help to get rid of a pot belly.
note: Stress falls on the second syllable: ab-DOM-i-nal.

definition: the rate at which a vehicle increases its speed
example: My only critique for my car was its acceleration.
exampleEs: La única crítica para mi coche fue su aceleración.
cloze: My only critique for my car was its ____.

definition: very strong or well developed, as a sense
example: A blind person's hearing is often very acute.
exampleEs: El oído de un ciego a menudo es muy agudo.
cloze: A blind person's hearing is often very ____.
note: Acute can also mean severe: an acute shortage is a very serious one.

definition: relating to beauty and the way something looks
example: I look at it from an aesthetic point of view.
exampleEs: Yo lo veo desde una perspectiva estética.
cloze: I look at it from an ____ point of view.
note: Pronounced es-THET-ik; British spelling is also 'aesthetic', not 'estetic'.

definition: creatures from another planet, as in science fiction
example: I dreamed I had been abducted by aliens.
exampleEs: Soñé que era abducido por los extraterrestres.
cloze: I dreamed I had been abducted by ____.
note: Alien can also mean a foreign resident, but here it means extraterrestre.

definition: the height of a place above sea level
example: In high altitudes, people find it hard to breathe.
exampleEs: En grandes altitudes la gente encuentra difícil respirar.
cloze: In high ____, people find it hard to breathe.

definition: the sound of people clapping to show approval
example: The astronauts were greeted with cheers and applause of an enthusiastic crowd.
exampleEs: Los astronautas fueron recibidos con aclamaciones y aplausos de una entusiasmada multitud.
cloze: The astronauts were greeted with cheers and ____ of an enthusiastic crowd.
note: Applause is uncountable: say 'applause', not 'applauses'.

definition: a sudden loud noise or dramatic ending
example: Quitting one's job with a bang is cathartic but is it the right thing to do?
exampleEs: Dimitir del trabajo con un portazo es catárquico pero ¿es lo más adecuado?
cloze: Quitting one's job with a ____ is cathartic but is it the right thing to do?

definition: to hit something hard so that it makes a loud noise
example: I banged on the door, but nobody answered.
exampleEs: Golpeé la puerta, pero nadie respondió.
cloze: I ____ on the door, but nobody answered.

definition: able to speak two languages equally well
example: Am I seriously the only one who isn't bilingual here?
exampleEs: ¿En serio soy el único que no es bilingüe aquí?
cloze: Am I seriously the only one who isn't ____ here?

definition: to lose blood from the body
example: Do your gums bleed when you brush your teeth?
exampleEs: ¿Te sangran las encías cuando te cepillas los dientes?
cloze: Do your gums ____ when you brush your teeth?
note: The past form is 'bled', not 'bleeded'.

definition: areas ruled and settled by people from another country
example: The colonies became independent states over the course of time.
exampleEs: Las colonias devinieron estados independientes con el curso del tiempo.
cloze: The ____ became independent states over the course of time.
note: A colony is a territory ruled by another country; the Mexican 'colonia' (neighborhood) is 'neighborhood'.

definition: new problems that make an illness or situation worse
example: Have you ever had any complications during past pregnancies?
exampleEs: ¿Has tenido alguna vez alguna complicación en anteriores embarazos?
cloze: Have you ever had any ____ during past pregnancies?

definition: the outline or shape of something such as land or a coast
example: The lava flow has already reached the sea and is changing the contours of the coastline.
exampleEs: El caudal de lava ya ha llegado al mar y está cambiando el contorno de la costa.
cloze: The lava flow has already reached the sea and is changing the ____ of the coastline.
note: Stress is on the first syllable: CON-tour.

definition: to say the opposite of what you said before
example: He contradicted himself several times in his testimony.
exampleEs: Se contradijo varias veces en su declaración.
cloze: He ____ himself several times in his testimony.
note: Followed by a direct object, no preposition: contradict someone, not contradict with someone.

definition: a difference between two statements or facts that cannot both be true
example: It's best not to try to reconcile the contradictions.
exampleEs: Es mejor no intentar reconciliar las contradicciones.
cloze: It's best not to try to reconcile the ____.

definition: saying or showing opposite things that cannot both be true
example: With so much contradictory information, one no longer knows what type of oils should be used for cooking.
exampleEs: Con tanta información contradictoria, uno ya no sabe qué tipo de aceites debe usar para cocinar.
cloze: With so much ____ information, one no longer knows what type of oils should be used for cooking.

definition: the outer layer of the brain
example: The cerebral cortex is made up of gray matter.
exampleEs: La corteza cerebral está compuesta por materia gris.
cloze: The cerebral ____ is made up of gray matter.
note: Plural is cortices or cortexes.

definition: the set of subjects and courses taught at a school or university
example: They have a very good curriculum at that university.
exampleEs: Tienen un muy buen currículo en esa universidad.
cloze: They have a very good ____ at that university.
note: Not a CV: in English a CV is a résumé; curriculum means a study program.

definition: slightly wet
example: After it rains and the ground is damp, it's easier to pull weeds.
exampleEs: Después de llover y estando el suelo húmedo, es más sencillo quitar la maleza.
cloze: After it rains and the ground is ____, it's easier to pull weeds.
note: Damp is only a little wet; wet means soaked.

definition: to make someone believe something that is not true
example: He deceived her, but even now she loves him.
exampleEs: Él le engañó a ella, pero incluso ahora ella le sigue queriendo.
cloze: He ____ her, but even now she loves him.
note: Deceive is not 'decepcionar'; that is disappoint.

definition: heavy and thick because its parts are packed closely together
example: Lead is a soft, dense, malleable and fusible metal.
exampleEs: El plomo es un metal blando, denso, maleable y fusible.
cloze: Lead is a soft, ____, malleable and fusible metal.

definition: to identify an illness or problem by looking at the signs
example: Have you ever been diagnosed with thyroid issues?
exampleEs: ¿Te han diagnosticado de problemas tiroideos alguna vez?
cloze: Have you ever been ____ with thyroid issues?
note: Use 'diagnosed with' an illness, not 'diagnosed of'.

definition: a form of a language used in one region or group
example: A dialect is a specific form of a language, spoken in a certain region.
exampleEs: Un dialecto es una forma específica de un idioma, que se habla en una cierta región.
cloze: A ____ is a specific form of a language, spoken in a certain region.
note: Stress is on the first syllable: DI-a-lect.

definition: a tiny particle with a negative charge found in atoms
example: Atoms are composed of protons, neutrons, and electrons.
exampleEs: Los átomos están compuestos de protones, neutrones y electrones.
cloze: Atoms are composed of protons, neutrons, and ____.
note: Stress is on the second syllable: e-LEC-tron.

definition: to remove writing or marks so they cannot be seen
example: It's written in pencil, so you can erase it.
exampleEs: Está escrito con lápiz, así que se puede borrar.
cloze: It's written in pencil, so you can ____ it.
note: Pronounced ih-RAYSS, with stress on the second syllable.

definition: describing growth that becomes faster and faster over time
example: The greatest shortcoming of the human race is our inability to understand the exponential function.
exampleEs: El mayor defecto de la raza humana es nuestra incapacidad para entender la función exponencial.
cloze: The greatest shortcoming of the human race is our inability to understand the ____ function.

definition: extreme tiredness
example: He fainted with hunger and fatigue, but came to after a while.
exampleEs: Se desmayó de hambre y fatiga, pero volvió en si un rato después.
cloze: He fainted with hunger and ____, but came to after a while.
note: Stress is on the second syllable: fa-TEEG; the -gue is pronounced /g/.

definition: a note printed at the bottom of a page
example: The footnotes are at the bottom of the page.
exampleEs: Las anotaciones están al pie de la página.
cloze: The ____ are at the bottom of the page.
note: Written as one word: footnote.

definition: disagreement or conflict between people or groups
example: Trade friction might arise between the two nations at any moment.
exampleEs: En cualquier momento pueden producirse fricciones comerciales entre los dos países.
cloze: Trade ____ might arise between the two nations at any moment.
note: In this sense friction means conflict; the physical sense is rubbing between surfaces.

definition: in a way that involves genes or DNA
example: Do you think it's dangerous to eat genetically modified food?
exampleEs: ¿Tú crees que es peligroso comer comida modificada genéticamente?
cloze: Do you think it's dangerous to eat ____ modified food?

definition: relating to the rules of how words are used in a language
example: That isn't a grammatical error, but a spelling one.
exampleEs: Eso no es un error de gramática, sino de ortografía.
cloze: That isn't a ____ error, but a spelling one.
note: Spelled with double m: grammatical, grammar.

definition: the natural place where an animal or plant lives
example: Wild animal attacks on the human population increase when their habitat is encroached upon and invaded.
exampleEs: Los ataques de animales salvajes a la población humana aumentan cuando esta se extiende e invade el hábitat de aquellos.
cloze: Wild animal attacks on the human population increase when their ____ is encroached upon and invaded.
note: Stress is on the first syllable: HAB-i-tat.

definition: something that seems real but is not
example: I've crossed the seas of eternity to understand that the notion of time is nothing but an illusion.
exampleEs: He cruzado los mares de la eternidad para entender que la noción de tiempo no es nada sino una ilusión.
cloze: I've crossed the seas of eternity to understand that the notion of time is nothing but an ____.
note: False friend: illusion is a false impression, not excitement or hope (that is 'ilusión' in Spanish).

definition: a sudden strong wish to do something without thinking
example: On a sudden impulse, I returned to my home town.
exampleEs: En un arranque me volví a mi pueblo.
cloze: On a sudden ____, I returned to my home town.
note: Say 'on impulse' or 'on a sudden impulse'.

definition: so good, big or extraordinary that it is hard to believe
example: It was one of the most incredible experiences of my life.
exampleEs: Fue una de las experiencias más increíbles de mi vida.
cloze: It was one of the most ____ experiences of my life.
note: Incredible (not believable) differs from incredulous (not believing).

definition: lower in quality or rank than something else
example: I think this one is inferior to that in quality.
exampleEs: Yo pienso que éste es inferior a ése en calidad.
cloze: I think this one is ____ to that in quality.
note: Use 'inferior to', not 'inferior than' or 'inferior that'.

definition: to push a liquid into the body using a needle
example: I have to use a needle to inject this under your skin.
exampleEs: Tengo que usar esta aguja para inyectarte esto bajo la piel.
cloze: I have to use a needle to ____ this under your skin.

definition: to stop someone while they are speaking
example: Why do you interrupt me all the time?
exampleEs: ¿Por qué me interrumpes todo el tiempo?
cloze: Why do you ____ me all the time?
note: Polite phrase in meetings: 'Sorry to interrupt, but...'.

definition: a traditional story from the past that may not be true
example: The legend says he was abandoned in the woods.
exampleEs: Cuenta la leyenda que él fue abandonado en el bosque.
cloze: The ____ says he was abandoned in the woods.
note: False friend: legend is a story; a map legend is also called a key.

definition: an author's text before it is printed as a book
example: He showed me the manuscript of his new play.
exampleEs: Él me enseñó el manuscrito de su nueva obra.
cloze: He showed me the ____ of his new play.
note: Stress is on the first syllable: MAN-yoo-script.

definition: a person whose job is to repair vehicles and machines
example: Take it to a mechanic, and get it fixed.
exampleEs: Llévalo a un mecánico a arreglar.
cloze: Take it to a ____, and get it fixed.

definition: to learn something so you can remember it exactly
example: This is the first time I've ever memorized a dialog.
exampleEs: Es la primera vez que me memorizo un diálogo.
cloze: This is the first time I've ever ____ a dialog.
note: British spelling is memorise. Say 'learn by heart', not 'learn of heart'.

definition: a way of describing something by saying it is something else
example: It's difficult to understand that author's texts, he uses a lot of metaphors.
exampleEs: Es difícil entender los textos de aquel autor, él utiliza muchas metáforas.
cloze: It's difficult to understand that author's texts, he uses a lot of ____.
note: Stress is on the first syllable: MET-uh-for; the ph is pronounced /f/.

definition: a small animal with dark fur that lives underground and sees very badly
example: You can't talk to a mole about the stars, they can't see them.
exampleEs: Con un topo no se puede hablar sobre las estrellas, no las puede ver.
cloze: You can't talk to a ____ about the stars, they can't see them.
note: Mole has other meanings: a spot on the skin, or a spy inside an organization.

definition: the study of how words are formed from smaller parts
example: Grammar is divided into phonology, morphology, syntax and semantics.
exampleEs: La gramática está dividida en fonología, morfología, sintaxis y semántica.
cloze: Grammar is divided into phonology, ____, syntax and semantics.
note: Stress is on the second syllable: mor-FOL-o-gy.

definition: tidy and well organized
example: She always keeps her room neat and tidy.
exampleEs: Ella siempre tiene ordenada su pieza.
cloze: She always keeps her room ____ and tidy.
note: In casual US English, neat can also mean 'cool' or 'great'.

definition: a place built by birds or insects to live in and lay eggs
example: Now is not the time to agitate the hornet's nest.
exampleEs: No es el momento de azuzar el avispero.
cloze: Now is not the time to agitate the hornet's ____.
note: 'Stir up a hornet's nest' means to cause a lot of trouble.

definition: a gas with no color or smell that makes up most of the air
example: The atmosphere mostly consists of nitrogen and oxygen.
exampleEs: La atmósfera se compone en su mayor parte de nitrógeno y oxígeno.
cloze: The atmosphere mostly consists of ____ and oxygen.
note: Pronounced NY-truh-jen; the stress is on the first syllable.

definition: kind, generous and morally good in a way people admire
example: What a noble heart that good man has!
exampleEs: ¡Qué corazón noble que tiene ese buen hombre!
cloze: What a ____ heart that good man has!
note: Noble also means 'of high social rank'; here it describes good character.

definition: the central part of an atom
example: The atom's nucleus is surrounded by an electron cloud.
exampleEs: El núcleo del átomo está rodeado de una nube de electrones.
cloze: The atom's ____ is surrounded by an electron cloud.
note: Plural is nuclei (NOO-klee-eye).

definition: a living thing, such as a plant, an animal, or a tiny life form
example: This protein is crucial for the organism to function properly.
exampleEs: Esta proteína es importantísima para el buen funcionamiento del organismo.
cloze: This protein is crucial for the ____ to function properly.

definition: farthest from the center; on the outside part
example: How do you find food in outer space?
exampleEs: ¿Cómo encuentras comida en el espacio?
cloze: How do you find food in ____ space?

definition: a gas in the air that people and animals need to breathe
example: Trees give off oxygen and absorb carbon dioxide.
exampleEs: Los árboles entregan oxígeno y absorben dióxido de carbono.
cloze: Trees give off ____ and absorb carbon dioxide.
note: Stress the first syllable: OK-si-jen.

definition: a wrapped package that is sent by mail
example: Put a stamp on the parcel and post it.
exampleEs: Pon un sello en el paquete y mándalo por correo.
cloze: Put a stamp on the ____ and post it.
note: False friend: parcela is a plot of land. Here parcel is a package; US English often says package.

definition: chemicals used to kill insects and other animals that harm crops
example: Through genetic engineering, corn can produce its own pesticides.
exampleEs: Mediante la ingeniería genética, el maíz puede producir sus propios pesticidas.
cloze: Through genetic engineering, corn can produce its own ____.

definition: very unusual and impressive; extremely good
example: He lifted the car with his phenomenal strength.
exampleEs: Él levantó el automóvil gracias a su fuerza excepcional.
cloze: He lifted the car with his ____ strength.
note: Stress the second syllable: fuh-NOM-uh-nul.

definition: a person who studies ideas about life, truth, and knowledge
example: An immense monument was erected in honor of the eminent philosopher.
exampleEs: Se erigió un inmenso monumento en honor al eminente filósofo.
cloze: An immense monument was erected in honor of the eminent ____.
note: Spelling: ph, not f.

definition: of the cold areas near the North or South Pole
example: The seal is an animal from the polar region.
exampleEs: La foca es un animal de las regiones polares.
cloze: The seal is an animal from the ____ region.
note: Pronounced POH-ler.

definition: a dry substance made of very small pieces
example: The powder is light enough to float on water.
exampleEs: El polvo es suficientemente ligero como para flotar en el agua.
cloze: The ____ is light enough to float on water.
note: Powder is a fine dry substance; dust is the dirt that settles on surfaces.

definition: rain, snow, or hail that falls from the sky
example: Tomorrow we expect variable weather with a likely chance of precipitation.
exampleEs: Mañana esperamos intervalos nubosos con posibilidad de chubascos.
cloze: Tomorrow we expect variable weather with a likely chance of ____.
note: It means rain or snow, not 'rushing'. Stress: pre-sip-i-TAY-shun.

definition: animals that hunt and eat other animals
example: Birds are dangerous predators for tortoises and their eggs.
exampleEs: Las aves son peligrosos predadores para las tortugas y sus huevos.
cloze: Birds are dangerous ____ for tortoises and their eggs.
note: Spanish says depredador; English has no 'de-'.

definition: from a very early time in history
example: The mastery of fire was fundamental to the survival of primitive man.
exampleEs: El dominio del fuego fue fundamental para la supervivencia del hombre primitivo.
cloze: The mastery of fire was fundamental to the survival of ____ man.

definition: tiny parts of an atom that have a positive charge
example: Atoms are made up of protons, electrons and neutrons.
exampleEs: Los átomos están hechos de protones, electrones y neutrones.
cloze: Atoms are made up of ____, electrons and neutrons.
note: Pronounced PROH-ton, with stress on the first syllable.

definition: the regular beat of the heart that you can feel in your wrist
example: The doctor thought the patient's pulse was rather rapid.
exampleEs: El doctor pensó que el pulso del paciente era bastante rápido.
cloze: The doctor thought the patient's ____ was rather rapid.

definition: a frame or stand with bars or hooks for holding things
example: Fold the towel and place it on the towel rack.
exampleEs: Dobla la toalla y ponla en el toallero.
cloze: Fold the towel and place it on the towel ____.

definition: the distance from the center of a circle to its edge
example: How do you calculate the radius from the circumference?
exampleEs: ¿Cómo calcular el radio de una circunferencia?
cloze: How do you calculate the ____ from the circumference?
note: Pronounced RAY-dee-us; the plural is radii.

definition: so silly or unreasonable that it makes people laugh
example: Who would come up with such a ridiculous name?
exampleEs: ¿A quién se le ocurriría un nombre tan ridículo?
cloze: Who would come up with such a ____ name?

definition: pressed and moved something back and forth against a surface
example: My cat rubbed her head against my shoulder.
exampleEs: Mi gato frotó su cabeza contra mi hombro.
cloze: My cat ____ her head against my shoulder.

definition: money given to a student to help pay for studies
example: He was awarded a scholarship to do research for the foundation.
exampleEs: Se le otorgó una beca para hacer investigación para la fundación.
cloze: He was awarded a ____ to do research for the foundation.
note: It means beca (a financial award), not escolaridad.

definition: a feeling in the body or mind
example: One who listens to one's recorded voice has the sensation of listening to a stranger.
exampleEs: El que escucha por primera vez su voz grabada, tiene la sensación de estar escuchando a un extraño.
cloze: One who listens to one's recorded voice has the ____ of listening to a stranger.

definition: a spacecraft that flies into space and returns to Earth
example: The astronaut had to conduct many experiments in the space shuttle.
exampleEs: El astronauta debió llevar a cabo muchos experimentos en el transbordador espacial.
cloze: The astronaut had to conduct many experiments in the space ____.

definition: to not do or have something that you normally would
example: In order to lose weight some people skip meals.
exampleEs: Algunas personas se saltan comidas para perder peso.
cloze: In order to lose weight some people ____ meals.

definition: to spend time with other people in a friendly way
example: We have to consume less and socialize more.
exampleEs: Hay que consumir menos y socializar más.
cloze: We have to consume less and ____ more.

definition: a soft, silver-white chemical element found in salt
example: Table salt is composed of sodium and chlorine atoms.
exampleEs: La sal comúnde cocina está compuesta de átomos de sodio y cloro.
cloze: Table salt is composed of ____ and chlorine atoms.
note: Pronounced SOH-dee-um.

definition: a single thin piece of hair, thread, or wire
example: She twisted a strand of hair around her finger.
exampleEs: Ella retorció un mechón de pelo alrededor de su dedo.
cloze: She twisted a ____ of hair around her finger.

definition: long thin lines of a different color from the area around them
example: Decorated with blue and yellow stripes, the tie was very unfashionable.
exampleEs: Decorada por franjas azules y amarillas, la corbata no estaba muy a la moda.
cloze: Decorated with blue and yellow ____, the tie was very unfashionable.
note: Pronounced STRYP, rhyming with 'type'.

definition: the parts of a word, each with one vowel sound
example: Try to come up with a sentence that has fifteen syllables.
exampleEs: Intenta dar con una frase de quince sílabas.
cloze: Try to come up with a sentence that has fifteen ____.
note: Spelling: syl-la-ble, with a y and double l.

definition: to a very great degree
example: This was a terribly hot afternoon and I feel like my brain is empty.
exampleEs: Ésta fue una tarde terriblemente calurosa y yo tengo la sensación de que mi cerebro está vacío.
cloze: This was a ____ hot afternoon and I feel like my brain is empty.
note: It often just means 'very', as in 'terribly sorry', not only 'badly'.

definition: a statement in mathematics that has been proved
example: The final value theorem does not apply if the system is not stable.
exampleEs: El último teorema del valor no se aplica si el sistema no es estable.
cloze: The final value ____ does not apply if the system is not stable.
note: Pronounced THEE-uh-rum, stress on the first syllable.

definition: a long piece of writing for a university degree
example: I'll need at least three days to translate that thesis.
exampleEs: Necesitaré al menos tres días para traducir esa tesis.
cloze: I'll need at least three days to translate that ____.
note: The plural is theses, pronounced THEE-seez.

definition: the distance between the two opposite surfaces of something
example: Gauges are used to measure the thickness of wire.
exampleEs: Para medir el grosor de los alambres hay que usar calibradores.
cloze: Gauges are used to measure the ____ of wire.

definition: a long, very thin piece of cotton or silk used for sewing
example: Once a thread is tied, it's hard to untie.
exampleEs: Una vez que se ata un hilo, es difícil desatarlo.
cloze: Once a ____ is tied, it's hard to untie.
note: Thread also means a chain of messages in an online conversation.

definition: a long passage in the body, such as for air or food
example: Have you ever been treated for a urinary tract infection?
exampleEs: ¿Te han tratado alguna vez de una infección en el tracto urinario?
cloze: Have you ever been treated for a urinary ____ infection?

definition: shapes with three straight sides and three corners
example: Plato thought that the universe was made up of triangles.
exampleEs: Platón creía que el universo estaba hecho de triángulos.
cloze: Plato thought that the universe was made up of ____.
note: Stress the first syllable: TRY-ang-gul.

definition: from the hot, wet parts of the world near the equator
example: Mangrove forests only grow at tropical and subtropical latitudes near the equator because they cannot withstand freezing temperatures.
exampleEs: Los bosques de manglares solo crecen en latitudes tropicales y subtropicales cerca del ecuador porque no pueden soportar temperaturas bajo cero.
cloze: Mangrove forests only grow at ____ and subtropical latitudes near the equator because they cannot withstand freezing temperatures.

definition: plants and trees growing in a place
example: There were only a few patches of vegetation near the river.
exampleEs: Sólo había algunas manchas de vegetación cerca del río.
cloze: There were only a few patches of ____ near the river.

definition: a shared way of thinking that makes two people understand each other
example: I guess we're not on the same wavelength.
exampleEs: Imagino que no estamos en la misma longitud de onda.
cloze: I guess we're not on the same ____.
note: Idiom: 'on the same wavelength' means you understand each other well.
